However, as the booking is under the name of Antoine Cornet and the bank details provided are under a different name, we will need written confirmation from Mr. Antoine Cornet confirming that the shared bank details are correct and approved for processing.Once we receive the confirmation, we can proceed with the deposit refund.Thank you, and we look forward to your response.Kind regards,Chahana T.On Wed, Apr 8, 2026 8:15 AM,  wrote:Dear Vijay Hingorani,This confirms that we received your email and registered it as ticket #940821287. You can always reply to this email to add additional information. Meanwhile, please note the following:If you paid your security deposit with a payment link before or on arrival, your deposit will be refunded within seven working days.If you paid your security deposit with a credit/debit card or via bank transfer on arrival with your guest relation executive, please expect the deposit to be refunded within a maximum of 14 working days. If you paid your security deposit in cash, it would be refunded in cash within 7 working days.If you have stayed for more than 15 days, then your booking would be considered as a long-term booking. All long-term bookings will be refunded within 14 working days as well.The refund will be processed in full through your preferred mode of payment, subject to a property inspection.To ensure a prompt refund, we kindly request you provide your preferred mode of refund (credit card, local bank account, cash, or international wire) to your dedicated guest relations executive as soon as possible.
